command: PASTEORG $6E00BOOT_ACTIVE EQU $7D30BOOT_DEST EQU $7D31BOOT_BEST EQU $7DF5BOOT_SLOT_CHECK EQU $F30DBOOT_SELECT EQU $F2A3BOOT_CHOICE EQU $F1E6VPTR EQU $D0TZ_PTR EQU $D6START: BYTE "BS",1,3JMP DISPLAY_VERSIONDISPLAY_VERSION:LDA BOOT_ACTIVESTA RUNNING_SLOTCMP #$A0BEQ CHECK_RUNNINGCMP #$B0BEQ VER_LONG_16JMP RUNNING_BADVER_LONG_16:CHECK_RUNNING:STA BOOT_DESTSTA $E1STZ $E0JSR BOOT_SLOT_CHECKBCC RUNNING_BADLDY #$3ELDA ($E0),YSTA MON_CALLINYLDA ($E0),YSTA MON_CALL+1LDX #10JSR MON_PRINTLDA $7D00ORA #'0'JSR $7E6DLDX #11LDA $7D01CMP #$16BNE CPU_READYINXCPU_READY:JSR MON_PRINTLDX #13JSR MON_PRINTJSR $7E7FJSR $7E7FJSR BN_READLDA BN_LENGTHBEQ BOARD_UNNAMEDJSR BN_SHOWBRA RUNNING_LINEBOARD_UNNAMED:LDX #<UNNAMED_TEXTLDY #>UNNAMED_TEXTJSR PRINTRUNNING_LINE:LDX #<RUNNING_TEXTLDY #>RUNNING_TEXTJSR PRINTLDA RUNNING_SLOTJSR SLOT_LETTERLDX #<GEN_TEXTLDY #>GEN_TEXTJSR PRINTLDA RUNNING_SLOTSTA VPTR+1STZ VPTRLDY #11RUNNING_GEN:LDA (VPTR),YJSR $7E7CDEYCPY #7BNE RUNNING_GENJSR $7E7FBRA SLOT_LISTRUNNING_BAD:LDX #<BAD_RUN_TEXTLDY #>BAD_RUN_TEXTJSR PRINTSLOT_LIST:JSR BOOT_SELECTLDA BOOT_BESTSTA BOOT_ACTIVELDA #$A0JSR BOOT_CHOICELDA #$B0JSR BOOT_CHOICELDA RUNNING_SLOTSTA BOOT_ACTIVEJSR $7E7FSECRTSSLOT_LETTER:CMP #$B0LDA #'A'BCC SLOT_CHARLDA #'B'SLOT_CHAR:JMP $7E6DMON_PRINT:JMP (MON_CALL)PRINT:  STX VPTRSTY VPTR+1LDY #0PRINT_NEXT:LDA (VPTR),YBEQ PRINT_DONEJSR $7E6DINYBNE PRINT_NEXTINC VPTR+1BRA PRINT_NEXTPRINT_DONE:RTSUNNAMED_TEXT: BYTE "Board: unnamed",13,10,0RUNNING_TEXT: BYTE "Running: MONITOR ",0GEN_TEXT: BYTE ", gen ",0BAD_RUN_TEXT: BYTE 13,10,"Running monitor: INVALID",13,10,0RUNNING_SLOT: BYTE 0MON_CALL: FILL 2,0TZ_SUM: FILL 2,0TZ_CRC:LDA #$FFSTA TZ_SUMSTA TZ_SUM+1LDY #0TZ_CRC_BYTE:LDA (TZ_PTR),YEOR TZ_SUM+1STA TZ_SUM+1LDX #8TZ_CRC_BIT:ASL TZ_SUMROL TZ_SUM+1BCC TZ_CRC_NEXTLDA TZ_SUMEOR #$21STA TZ_SUMLDA TZ_SUM+1EOR #$10STA TZ_SUM+1TZ_CRC_NEXT:DEXBNE TZ_CRC_BITINYCPY #28BNE TZ_CRC_BYTERTSBN_READ:STZ BN_LENGTHSTZ BN_FREE+1LDX #3BN_RESET:STZ BN_SEQ,XDEXBPL BN_RESETLDA $7FECPHAAND #$11ORA #$EESTA $7FECSTZ TZ_PTRLDA #$9CSTA TZ_PTR+1BN_SLOT:LDY #0BN_BLANK:LDA (TZ_PTR),YCMP #$FFBNE BN_CHECKINYCPY #32BNE BN_BLANKLDA BN_FREE+1BEQ VB_LONG_56JMP BN_NEXTVB_LONG_56:LDA TZ_PTRSTA BN_FREELDA TZ_PTR+1STA BN_FREE+1JMP BN_NEXTBN_CHECK:LDY #31LDA (TZ_PTR),YBEQ VB_LONG_65JMP BN_NEXTVB_LONG_65:LDY #3BN_HEADER:LDA (TZ_PTR),YCMP BN_MAGIC,YBNE BN_NEXTDEYBPL BN_HEADERJSR TZ_CRCLDY #28LDA (TZ_PTR),YCMP TZ_SUMBNE BN_NEXTINYLDA (TZ_PTR),YCMP TZ_SUM+1BNE BN_NEXTLDY #8LDA (TZ_PTR),YCMP #9BCS BN_NEXTSTA BN_WORKTAXBN_CHAR_CHECK:INYCPY #17BEQ BN_NEWESTLDA (TZ_PTR),YCPX #0BEQ BN_PADDINGCMP #$21BCC BN_NEXTCMP #$7FBCS BN_NEXTDEXJMP BN_CHAR_CHECKBN_PADDING:CMP #0BNE BN_NEXTJMP BN_CHAR_CHECKBN_NEWEST:LDY #7LDX #3BN_NEWER:LDA (TZ_PTR),YCMP BN_SEQ,XBCC BN_NEXTBNE BN_KEEPDEYDEXBPL BN_NEWERBN_KEEP:LDY #7LDX #3BN_COPY_SEQ:LDA (TZ_PTR),YSTA BN_SEQ,XDEYDEXBPL BN_COPY_SEQLDA BN_WORKSTA BN_LENGTHLDY #9LDX #0BN_COPY:LDA (TZ_PTR),YSTA BN_TEXT,XINYINXCPX #8BNE BN_COPYBN_NEXT:LDA TZ_PTRCLCADC #32STA TZ_PTRBCC BN_PAGEINC TZ_PTR+1BN_PAGE:LDA TZ_PTR+1CMP #$A0BEQ VB_LONG_146JMP BN_SLOTVB_LONG_146:PLASTA $7FECRTSBN_SHOW:JSR BN_READLDA BN_LENGTHBEQ BN_SHOW_DONELDX #<BN_LABELLDY #>BN_LABELJSR PRINTLDX #0BN_PRINT:LDA BN_TEXT,XJSR $7E6DINXCPX BN_LENGTHBNE BN_PRINTJMP $7E7FBN_SHOW_DONE:RTSBN_MAGIC: BYTE "BN",1,0BN_LABEL: BYTE "Board: ",0BN_LENGTH: BYTE 0BN_WORK: BYTE 0BN_TEXT: FILL 8,0BN_SEQ: FILL 4,0BN_FREE: FILL 2,0APP_END:END.
